name: Unified Theory (Legendary Games)
body:
You have learned to enhance any veil you shape instead of just a single one.

Prerequisite(s): At least 1 veil known with the Enhanced descriptor.

Benefit(s): You may add enhancement bonuses, weapon, armor, and shield special qualities, as well as special materials to this feat as if it were a veil with the Enhanced descriptor and produced an appropriate armor, weapon, or shield. Each Armor, Weapon, and Shield enhancements are considered a separate ‘track’ (for example, you can upgrade this feat as a +1 flaming weapon, a +2 adamantine shield, and as a +1 spell resistance armor).

Whenever you shape a veil with an Enhanced descriptor with a weapon, armor, or shield, you may apply the enhancement bonuses, special qualities, and special materials from this weapon to the weapon, armor, or shield respectively.

Akashic Classes: Kheshig © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Anthony Cappel.
